hypotheses.text: Reviewer cycle 0 found role statements demoted to review. Hypothesis: the markers read too wide a vocabulary, not too wide a rule: (1) OTHER_ROLES takes most/other and teams ('other teams', 'Like most roles') — narrow to some/many/certain/select roles/positions/jobs/openings plus a sentence-initial 'Positions that'; (2) OPTION_BEFORE takes ability/flexibility, which are requirements — keep option/opportunity/choice/possibility/optional and refuse under requires/must/needs to; (3) a sentence whose subject is this role/position/job (not after if/when) is about the role — it blocks other-roles, option, company-model and perk demotions; COMPANY_OWNER refuses follows/part of/subject to/under and role's; (4) REMOTE_AFTER refuses a remote mode followed within 40 chars by a day count or weekday (a hybrid week's breakdown); (5) the presence check for perks, the company model and a negation reads the raw 160 chars after (across ; and .), and a heading Location/Work model/Work arrangement in the last 50 chars before blocks a perk. Prediction: every reviewer row excludes, the 17 company-level rows stay needs-review, and the RemoteJobs.org movers stay 20 (or lose only the ambiguous).

Re-review of cycle 1: a contrast after a subset ('Many of our roles are remote, but this is a hybrid role', 'While many positions are remote, this one requires 3 days a week in the Austin office') still demotes, and a role stated remote ('This position is 100% remote, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule') now wrongly blocks its option. Hypothesis: SOME_ROLES must count only when no contrast or role reference (but, however, whereas, yet, unlike-after, this is, this one, this role/position/job, you will/you'll) lies between the subset phrase and the statement; ROLE_SUBJECT must not block when the same sentence says the role is (fully/100%) remote or remote-first; plus four narrowings: NOT_A_BREAKDOWN also refuses twice/once/most days/some days/alternate/every other/half/occasionally, REMOTE_MODE refuses remote-first/-friendly, PREFERENCE needs the candidate (you/candidates/applicants … prefer), CONDITIONS read 'you are based/located/live/reside in|within|near' not 'you are in', COMPANY_OWNER refuses join/joining, REQUIREMENT drops a bare 'required' (keeps 'required to'), and ROLE_LOCATION reads the raw 50 characters before. Prediction: every re-review row excludes, the four wrongly-excluded company cases go to review, the 17 company rows and the 20 RemoteJobs.org movers stay.
